theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_truncation_superlevel_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ → ℝ) (C ε t : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → LocallyIntegrableOn H U V.weight → 0 ≤ C → (∀ g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → ∫ x in {x | 1 ≤ g x}, g x ∂V.weight ≤ C * (∫ x, g x ∂V.weight) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∫ x, (‖V.tangentialGradient g x‖ + g x * ‖H x‖) ∂V.weight) → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ U → (∀ x, 0 ≤ h x) → Integrable (fun x ↦ ‖V.tangentialGradient h x‖) V.weight → ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → Monotone γ → (∀ s, 0 ≤ γ s ∧ γ s ≤ 1) → (∀ s, s ≤ 0 → γ s = 0) → 0 < ε → (∀ s, ε ≤ s → γ s = 1) → 0 ≤ t → V.weight.real {x | t + ε < h x} ≤ C * (V.weight.real {x | t < h x}) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((∫ x, deriv γ (h x - t) * ‖V.tangentialGradient h x‖ ∂V.weight) + ∫ x in {x | t < h x}, ‖H x‖ ∂V.weight)
